title: Tab bars | Apple Developer Documentation - [iPadOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tab-bars\#iPadOS)
claim: Prefer a tab bar for navigation.** A tab bar provides access to the sections of your app that people use most. If your app is more complex, you can provide the option to convert the tab bar to a sidebar so people can access a wider set of navigation options.
supporting_text: **Prefer a tab bar for navigation.** A tab bar provides access to the sections of your app that people use most. If your app is more complex, you can provide the option to convert the tab bar to a sidebar so people can access a wider set of navigation options.
